objective: For G = H(F_q) x| C_r with a, b, ab all nontrivial (q odd, and the cases with no diagonal obstruction for q even): counting maps on r-surgeries of knots is #P-hard. Four coincidence patterns of (a, b, (ab)^-1) give four Potts gadgets (q colours at v = q - 1; q^2 colours at v = q - 1 twice; q^3 colours at v = q^2 - 1), all off the special Tutte hyperbola; base manifolds are connected sums of twist knots with the needed Alexander roots. Check the gadget formulas by brute force and at least one new case end to end.
status: Proved by COPRIME-CLASS2-20261026-001D-P001: for G = H(F_p) x| C_r (p odd, r | p - 1) acting by (a x, b y, a b z) with a, b and ab all nontrivial, counting homomorphisms from pi1 of r-surgeries on knots, and from knot groups, is #P-hard under Turing reductions; four Potts gadgets (one per coincidence pattern of a, b, (ab)^-1) on Tutte hyperbolas p^2 or p^3, realized by an explicit construction from twist-knot sums with disjoint Y-graphs and pure leaves. With C this is a dichotomy for these groups; Rowell's Conjecture 3.2(b) fails for them unless every #P function is polynomial-time computable. Checked by brute force and on three end-to-end knots.
title: With a hard pair, Heisenberg counting is #P-hard with H1 = Z/r
